what_happened: Scene: layout 10, grey 4-slot (two-pair) toaster at the far left of the counter, bread in the left-most slot (pair 0). Stage 0: by 300 the gripper was at the toaster's front with the LEFT (correct) lever handle at the bottom centre of the wrist view. It closed into a fist at 338-368 and touched the lever area 349-363 and 387-524, but moved the lever only 0.008. It never pushed it down. 614-670 the fist went over the toaster top next to the bread (bread contact 638-641, no lift), and 744-800 it touched the top/front again with no effect (lever max 0.02). It then backed off to the right: 848-1600 it hovered at the toaster's right end with the bread in view, with brief touches at 1055-1060 and 1128-1131. By 1800-2000 it had turned to the toaster oven on the other counter. The toaster was never on and the bread stayed in the slot.
causal_chain: reached the correct (left) lever by ~340 but never pushed it down (340-524, value <= 0.008) -> poked at the toaster top and bread (614-800) -> hovered at the right end 848-1600 -> turned to the toaster oven -> toaster never on
uncertain_about: Whether the fist was on top of the lever handle (pressing too lightly) or just below it (pushing against the housing) during 349-524.
